This is Obi-Wan Kenobi declaring a Nine Thirteen Emergency!|Obi-Wan Kenobi above [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Emergency Code Nine Thirteen''' was a code used by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==Usage==
Code Nine Thirteen was a simple code transmitted by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to find other Knights during certain extenuating situations. The signal would activate the [[Jedi beacon transceiver|beacon transceiver]] of any Jedi in range, displaying the location of the code's source on the transceiver screen.

Following the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] sent out a Code Nine Thirteen transmission aboard [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' [[Belbullab-22 starfighter/Legends|captured starfighter]] in the [[Utapau system/Legends|Utapau system]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], having appropriated a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] from [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin's]] ''[[Sharp Spiral]]'', locked on to Obi-Wan's broadcast, and directed him to a rendezvous with the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']].
